E1 grant remains engaged per brief, session_notes and measure cells 32/46. Same kernel; operator restored state0 (cell 44). A/B passed: setup executed, SAFETIES cell 18 exec 10 exactly matches card (TG -0.3..1, BG -1.3..2, Si +/-25 V, B +/-10 T, T 0..100 K). Live comparison repeats before measurement. No safety or pacing changes.

1. DONE Gate C: runs 0–3 confirm B_1–B_2 voltage and B_3 drain-current liveness and gate currents inside 1 nA. No external baseline exists or is permitted.
2. DONE, provisional calibration: run 5 map after clipped run 4. Main neutrality ridge slope -0.7728, intercept +0.0512 V; second ridge around -0.426e12 cm^-2 on main-ridge coordinate. These are electrical features within ONE measured contact pair, not separately addressable regions. Capacitance ratio data-derived; absolute scale geometry-anchored; D origin from resistance symmetry remains a hypothesis, not proof of inversion symmetry.
3. DONE spots: runs 6/7 at nominal D=0, n=+3.2/-1.2e12. Analyze and promote now. Electron R signed -33..530 ohm, hole -0.4..587 ohm, drain 9.81..9.94 nA; max leakage 216 pA. Multiple frequency candidates are not a stacking verdict; zero crossings make log(abs(R)) harmonics suspect.
4. NEXT landau-fan: B=0 baseline then 1..6 T by 0.1 T (52 rows), co-sweep TG/BG on run-5 nominal D=0 line; n=-1.2..3.2e12 by .04 (111 points). Si=0. 3 s dwell (10 tau for 0.3 s/24 dB/oct), fixed 100 uV voltage sensitivity, 20 mV current sensitivity. Preserve signed voltage, current, phase, gate leakage, both temperatures and field readback. Revalidate assumptions at entry and thermometry freshness every row. Stop automatically on >1 nA leakage, temperature excursion, gross current loss or clipping; preserve partial data and hold rather than blind parking. Magnet interrupt does not stop an in-flight supply ramp.
   Purpose: map branches and crossings versus gate coordinate, assess whether multiple fans share one neutrality origin or are shifted copies, and constrain absolute lever arm only where indexing is defensible. Bernal-like two bilayer sectors, rhombohedral-like quartic sector, mixed linear+cubic sectors are qualitative hypotheses, not frequency-count identities. A disorder/mosaic explanation remains live.
   Sampling: 0.04e12 grid resolves fourfold density period (0.0967e12 per tesla) with >=4.8 points above 2 T; 1..2 T is reconnaissance and cannot resolve every branch. At high n, fine low-B oscillations can alias in 0.1 T steps. No FFT or index claim from undersampled portions. Raw gate axes accompany provisional n axes.
   Price: run 5 median 1.0985 s/point at 1 s dwell and NPLC=1 -> >=3.10 s/point at 3 s dwell. Allow 3.25 s with extra readbacks + ~10 s row flyback/settle; 52*111*3.25/3600 + 52*10/3600 + 6*7.3/60 = 6.09 h; +10% = 6h45m. Full same-resolution 6..10 T adds ~5 h; defer until topology warrants it. Full D=0 gate-limited window (-1.27..3.27) adds only edge points but little diagnostic leverage and less validator margin. Negative field and D dependence deferred.
   Checkpoints: first points and first two complete rows (~15 min); every 4 rows (~25 min) thereafter, plus topology at 2 T and 4 T. Use hera-watch. Inspect leakage, phase, current and sensitivity; continue only with useful structure. At washout stop and re-read actual state before any move.
5. ADAPT after fan: clean raw plots first, signed V/I map, then density derivatives / branch tracks, index only robust minima. Compare alternative assignments under capacitance uncertainty and two-origin confound. If needed, a targeted D cut or denser fan uses current field and alternates direction; propose separately with cost, never automatic blanket campaign.
6. FINAL ana cell: B_1–B_2 verdict ABAB/ABCA/ABCB/cannot tell + strength, numerical run-cited evidence and overturning observations. No independent region verdict on disconnected sr2/sr3. If unresolved use calibrated cannot tell.
7. Close-out only after operator return-to-initial decision: B=0, TG/BG/Si=0 at committed pacing, both heater ranges off, readbacks recorded in session_notes.
EOF

text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > hera_scratch/md_spots_analysis.md <<'EOF'
## Runs 6–7 — field spots before the first Landau fan (plan step 3)

Raw sr1 voltage and measured drain current appear first below, followed by signed V/I and a linear signed-R spectrum. Run 6 (nominal n=+3.2e12 cm^-2) spans -32.95..529.63 ohm; run 7 (n=-1.2e12) spans -0.38..586.87 ohm. Drain current stays 9.809..9.935 nA, gate leakage below 216 pA, sample temperature 1.165..1.292 K; voltage peaks 5.22/5.76 uV are far below 50 uV sensitivity. Both sides support a fan; sr1 is the sole wired voltage pair B_1–B_2.

The electron trace has negative excursions. Preserve its sign; a log(abs(R)) spectrum distorts zero crossings and cannot establish independent pockets or stacking. The onset helper's electron 0.30 T result is censored at its analysis edge, while the hole result is ~0.71 T; treat these as reconnaissance diagnostics, not rigorous onset or density calibration. Linear signed-R spectra over 1–10 T show electron candidates near 7.8/14.4/22.2/30.0 T and hole candidates near 4.4/6.7/12.2 T; harmonics, background, and the second neutrality ridge confound frequency counting. **Current call: cannot tell stacking.** Plan step 4 will map branch origins/crossings at nominal D=0, with both raw gate and provisional density coordinates; absolute capacitance and D origin remain unverified. The earlier map's two ridges are not independently wired spatial regions.
EOF

open('hera_scratch/ana_spots.py','w').write(s)
PY
